comment:
* Generic interface for receiving a callback result from someone. * Allow the server end to synchronously wait on the response from the client. * This enables an RPC like system but with the ability to timeout and discard late results. * *

NOTE: Use the static {@link #get} method to retrieve an available instance of this class. * If no instances are available, a new one is created.

methods.name: public void send(@Nullable T resultData)
methods.comment:
* Deliver a result to this receiver.
     *
     * @param resultData Additional data provided by you.

methods.name: public void propagateException(@NonNull RuntimeException e)
methods.comment:
* Deliver an {@link Exception} to this receiver
     *
     * @param e exception to be sent

methods.name: public Result<T> awaitResultNoInterrupt(@NonNull Duration timeout) throws TimeoutException
methods.comment:
* Blocks waiting for the result from the remote client.
     *
     * If it is interrupted before completion of the duration, wait again with remaining time until
     * the deadline.
     *
     * @param timeout The duration to wait before sending a {@link TimeoutException}
     * @return the Result
     * @throws TimeoutException if the timeout in milliseconds expired.

methods.name: public void writeToParcel(@NonNull Parcel out, int flags)
